request.description: Always "launch": the debugger compiles and runs the program.

target.description: Which debugger to use. Without it, the build's output decides: --interp and --run use eval, --cpp hxcpp, --cppia a cppia host (see program), --hl HashLink, --js js-debug with Node. "eval" with any other build debugs its macros and writes no output.

hxml.description: The .hxml to build, relative to cwd. Without it (and without haxeArgs or program), the hxml the Haxe language server uses, else one that runs with --interp or --run, else the only one.

haxeArgs.description: Haxe command-line arguments, instead of hxml.

command.description: A project tool's command that builds and runs the program, instead of hxml: Lime's (lime, openfl or haxelib run lime, with test, build or run and a target: desktop, hl or html5) or Ceramic's (ceramic <backend> run <target>: linux, mac, windows or web). The debugger runs a debug build of it. Any other command needs "target": "hxcpp" and must start a program built with -debug and hxcpp-debug-server. Without command, hxml, haxeArgs or program, a Lime or Ceramic project in the project folder is built with its own tool, for the target the Haxe language server uses.

program.description: hxcpp: the program to run, relative to cwd. Without hxml or haxeArgs, a program already built (with -debug and hxcpp-debug-server), so nothing is built. Default: the executable the build makes. cppia: the host that runs the script, an hxcpp -debug build with -D scriptable and hxcpp-debug-server. HashLink: the .hl file to run. Default: the build's. JavaScript: the .js file to run. Default: the build's. Without hxml or haxeArgs, a program already built, with its source maps.

args.description: hxcpp, cppia, HashLink and JavaScript: the program's arguments. For cppia, default: the script's path.

env.description: hxcpp, cppia, HashLink and JavaScript: environment variables for the program, added to Zed's.

port.description: hxcpp and cppia: port the program's debug server connects to. Default: a free one, or for a program built elsewhere or with its own -lib hxcpp-debug-server, that library's port (6972 unless -D HXCPP_DEBUG_PORT says otherwise). HashLink: port the debugger talks to the VM on. Default: 6112.

hl.description: HashLink: the VM to run the program with. Default: hl on PATH.

url.description: JavaScript: open this page in a browser instead of running the program with Node, for a page served elsewhere. Without it but with webRoot, the debugger serves webRoot on localhost.

webRoot.description: JavaScript: the folder the page and its scripts are in, relative to cwd. Setting it opens the page in a browser instead of running the program with Node. Default with url: the program's folder.

browser.description: JavaScript in a browser: the Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave executable to use. Default: one of those on PATH, else an installed Chrome.

runtimeExecutable.description: JavaScript: the Node to run the program with. Default: node on PATH, else the one Zed runs.

cwd.description: Folder to run Haxe and the hxcpp program in. Default: the project folder.

stopOnEntry.description: eval and JavaScript: pause before the first line runs.

stopAllThreads.description: hxcpp: when a thread stops, stop the other threads too. Without it, only the thread that stopped does, and continue and the steps let only it go. Default: Zed-Haxe's project setting debug.stopAllThreads, else true.

haxePath.description: Haxe executable to use. Default: the one the Haxe language server would pick (.haxerc with lix or haxe-manager, else PATH).

mergeScopes.description: eval: show locals, captured variables and arguments as one list.

showGeneratedVariables.description: eval: also show variables the compiler generated.

traceFile.description: For extension development: append every DAP message the bridge relays to this file.
